The following is the statement of Wong Foh Ming.
native of Wuchow taken by Mr. C.D.G. 82.
at Louza Stn. on the 17-10-38. and interpreted by Clerk Chen.

I am a teaboy(No. 33) in the China Hotel, Kweicho Road.
On the 17-10-38, when I was on day duty on the 4th floor with
another teaboy No. 37 named Hong Shih Ding, I saw a male
Chinese of slim build, wearing black long gown coming at about
3 p.m. even date, who was attended to by No. 37 teaboy in
engaging Room No. 410. About 3 or 4 minutes after paying the
room fee the man left the room and returned in company with
another male Chinese wearing brown long gown. They both
entered the room and at about 5.30 p.m. same date, they came
out of the room again. About 5 minutes later, when I was
entering an account in the book, I suddenly saw a male Chinese
in foreign dress with his face smeared with Blood. I did not
see which room he came from. The injured man approached me
saying that he was shot by 2 robbers and asked for a towel
to stop bleeding. Consequently my comrade Hong Shih Ding went
downstairs and reported the fact to the accountant of the
Hotel. A ricksha was called by the private detective Zung
Tsoh Sai, and the injured man was conveyed to the Station.
According to the injured person he said he was the occupant
of Room 410 but I did not see when he came.

我是贵州路中国饭店的茶房（编号 33）。1938 年 10 月 17 日，我与另一名编号 37、名为洪世鼎（Hong Shih Ding）的茶房在四楼值白班。当日下午 3 时许，我看见一名身材瘦削、身穿黑色长衫的中国男子前来，由 37 号茶房接待并入住 410 号房间。该男子支付房费后约三四分钟离开房间，随后与另一名身穿棕色长衫的中国男子一同返回。两人进入房间，并于当日下午 5 时 30 分许再次走出房间。约五分钟后，当我正在账簿上记账时，突然看见一名身穿西装、满脸血迹的中国男子。我没看清他是从哪个房间出来的。受伤者走近我，称自己被两名劫匪枪击，并索要毛巾止血。于是我的同事洪世鼎下楼向饭店会计报告此事。私家侦探钟佐才（Zung Tsoh Sai）叫来一辆人力车，将受伤者送往捕房。据受伤者称，他是 410 号房间的住客，但我并未看见他何时到来。

The following is the statement of Hong Shih Ding.
native of Kiangwan taken by C.D.C. 88.
at Louza Stn. on the 17-10-38. and interpreted by Clerk Chen.

I am a teyboy in the China Hotel, Kweichow Road. I was
on day duty on the 17-10-38, when at about 3 p.m. a male
Chinese slim build wearing black long gown came up to the 4th
floor and engaged room No. 410 under the name of Wong Kyi.
The man paid $10 deposit and after about 4 minutes he left
the room and returned at about 4.30 p.m. with another male
Chinese wearing a brown long gown. They both entered the room
when I served the tea. At about 5.30 p.m. even date, the two
men again emerged from the room whereupon I approached them and
asked the man "Wong" if any other person was in the room, to
which he said that Mr "Zung" was in there. They walked away
hurriedly and after 3 or 4 minutes a male Chinese, in foreign
dress, with his face smeared with blood came out from Room
410 and ran to our accounting desk saying that he was shot by
2 robbers. On seeing this, I immediately reported the fact
to the accountant. Consequently the private detective Zung
Tsoh Sai called a ricksha to send the injured man to the Station.
I did not see the injured man arrive at the hotel or enter Room
410.

CHINA PRESS.

OCT 1 8 1938

Attempt On
Doctor's Life
Made In Hotel

Cantonese Medico In
Serious Condition
With Head Wound

Dr. Liu Pao-kwung, Cantonese medical practitioner, was lying in the Police Hospital in a serious but not dangerous condition last night following an attack upon his person which took place in the China Hotel, Kweichow Road, shortly after 5 p.m. yesterday.

Police are still groping in a fog of mystery, for the assault so far has defied all logical conclusions.

At 4 p.m. Dr. Liu received a telephone message asking him to call upon a social disease case in room 410 at the China Hotel. He arrived at 5 p.m., and upon entering the room was assaulted. Acid was thrown into his eyes and he was beaten over the head with a blunt instrument which is thought to have been the butt of a revolver.

It is also understood that the physician had connections with Japanese.

The head of a .32 caliber bullet, a hat with holes which may have been caused by a bullet's penetration, also figure somehow in the case. Police were not completely discounting the possibility of a connection between the assault and yesterday's attempted assassination of Tsau Sheh-kung, general director of the Japan-sponsored puppet "Consolidated Tax Bureau." The connection, however, is still vague.

In his pocket was found a letter addressed to the S.M.C. Public Health Department applying for registration.

In 1932 complainant instituted his own medical office
at his present address, No.47 Tiendong Road, and
registered himself as a doctor with the Shanghai
Doctors' Union and also the Public Health Bureau of the
Shanghai City Government (Verified).

About six years ago complainant married his
present wife named Sing Wei Ying (沈惠英), who is a
qualified doctor, and who from 1935 until the outbreak
of the Sino-Japanese Hostilities on 13-8-37, operated
the Hwa Nyien (華年) Eye Hospital at No.2 Tung Hwa Li
(東華里) off Tongshan Road. This hospital was reopened
by complainant's wife on or about 1-10-38 as a result
of her having obtained a Japanese Military "Pass", and
since then she has conducted her practice there.

Complainant's practice has, since the outbreak
of hostilities, been in a rather depressed condition
with an income of about $100.00 per month, but sufficient
for him to exist without sustaining financial difficul-
ties.

于此五至六年，随后前往杭州，在李明扬将军麾下的国民革命军中担任军医。在该职位任职约三年后，报案人返回上海。1932年，报案人在其现址天潼路47号开设了自己的诊所，并在上海医师公会及上海市政府卫生局注册为医生（已核实）。

约六年前，报案人与现任妻子沈惠英（Sing Wei Ying，音译）结婚，其妻为合格医师，自1935年起至1937年8月13日中日战事爆发前，在通山路东华里2号经营华年眼科医院。由于获得了日军颁发的“通行证”，报案人之妻于1938年10月1日前后重新开放该医院，此后一直在此执业。

自战事爆发以来，报案人的诊所经营状况较为低迷，月收入约100美元，但足以维持生计，未陷入财务困境。

Complainant was then placed in a seated position on the
edge of the bath tube whereupon the 2nd described is
alleged to have written something on his forehead with
a Chinese pen. Following this the 2nd described attempted
to push complainant into a lying position in the bath
tube but complainant exerted his strength and forced
his right hand free from the handcuffs. Complainant was
then, however, forced to the floor (with his face facing
the floor ) by the 3rd described who kneeled on him and
struck him several times about the scalp with the butt
of the pistol and, at the same time, shouted "K! K! K!"
meaning fire shots. One or two shots were then fired
and complainant felt his head bleeding and became
unconscious. Later complainant discovered that he was
covered with a bed quilt and that the three men had gone.
He then untied his feet and, walking to the corridor, he
raised an alarm which attracted the roomboys. He recalls
that whilst in the room the 1st described, on pointing
the pistol at his chest, accused him of being a Chinese
traitor and that after he had been handcuffed, the men
stated that whether they killed or released him depended
on the result of their investigations. The men had
searched complainant but did not take away anything.

K!”，意为开枪。随后响起了一两声枪响，报案人感到头部流血，随即失去知觉。后来报案人发现自己身上盖着一条床被，那三名男子已经离开。于是他解开脚上的束缚，走到走廊呼救，引起了服务员的注意。他回忆说，在房间里时，第一名男子用枪指着他的胸口，指控他是汉奸；在他被戴上手铐后，那些人表示，是杀是放取决于他们调查的结果。那些人搜过报案人的身，但没有拿走任何东西。

Liu Hsiu Eu (劉守安) alias Liu Zoong Zu
age 36, M/doctor,
Canton
D.I. Loh Kung Sung
Police Hospital 17th Oct.1938 translated ////// Clerk Sih Yun Pai.

I was born in Shanghai. My wife is one Liu Zung
Sz (劉陳氏), native of Canton, who married to me in Shanghai
at her 25th year of age (about six years ago). I have been
residing at No.47 Tiendong Road since my birth. My parents
died. I have no brothers but two sisters. My cousin named
Voong Zai Sung (馮瑞生), is employed as an Inspector attached
to Chengtu Road Police Station.

When I was 16 years old, I began to work as an
apprentice at the Mei Chong (美昌) Printing Shop, North
Szechuen Road. Leaving the above job at my 22nd year of
age I was employed by Mr. Husk (?), an American Doctor, at
No.15 Nanking Road, as his assistant and also an interpreter.
Two years later, I entered the Dah Tsoong (大中) Hospital,
corner of Tiendong and North Chekiang Roads. After remaining
in the said hospital for a period of about 5-6 years, I left
and proceeded to Hangchow, where I obtained employment as
a Military Doctor attached to the Nationalist Army under Gen.
Li Ming Yang (李明揚). I remained on this job for about
three years and then returned to Shanghai.

In the year 1932, I practiced my own business as
a doctor at the above address - 47 Tiendong Road, registering
my name at the Shanghai Doctors' Union and also the Public
Health Bureau of the Shanghai City Government.

Since the outbreak of Sino-Japanese Hostilities on
Aug. 13th, 1937, my business was in a depressed condition, say
about $100.00 obtainable from practicing a month, I could,
however, exist without sustaining difficulties in finance.

(劉頌時)
刘守安（Liu Hsiu Eu），又名刘宗祖（Liu Zoong Zu）
36岁，男/医生，

罗公松（Loh Kung Sung）侦探长
警察医院 1938年10月17日 翻译 ////// 书记员 Sih Yun Bai.

我出生于上海。我的妻子刘陈氏（Liu Zung Sz），广东籍，在上海与我结婚，当时她25岁（大约六年前）。我自出生以来一直居住在天潼路47号。父母已故。我没有兄弟，只有两个姐妹。我的表弟馮瑞生（Voong Zai Sung），受雇为成都路警署的巡官。

我16岁时，开始在四川北路的美昌印刷店当学徒。22岁时离开上述工作，受雇于南京路15号的美国医生Husk先生（?），担任他的助手兼翻译。两年后，我进入位于天潼路与浙江北路转角的大中医院。在该医院工作了约5-6年后，我离开前往杭州，在那里受雇为李明扬将军麾下国民革命军的军医。我从事这份工作约三年，然后返回上海。

1932年，我在上述地址——天潼路47号自行开业行医，并在上海医师公会和上海市政府卫生局注册了我的名字。

自1937年8月13日中日敌对行动爆发以来，我的生意处于萧条状态，每月行医收入约100.00美元，不过，我仍能维持生计，未陷入财务困境。

pages.en:
Sheet No.2.

Until the outbreak of "813" Hostilities my wife
Liu Zung Sz was the proprietress of the Hwa Nyien (華年) Eye
Hospital, at No.2 Tung Hwa Li (東華里) off Tongshan Road, for
two years. At the beginning of this month (October), my
wife having obtained a "pass" returned to the above hospital,
carrying on her practice.

The above hospital was established by my wife Liu
Zung Sz who was a graduate of the China Medical Academy,
Ocular Class, Range Road, in the year 1935.

At about 4.p.m. to-day (17-10-38), a telephone call
was received from some person who stated that my services
were requested to attend a patient in the China Hotel, adding
that he would send someone for me a little while later. It
was a very common thing that I attended patient in hotel so
I took no notice over the telephone arrangements.

About half an hour later, a male Chinese, whose
description is as follows:
Age about 22/3, pale long face, long hair, parted,
wearing a dark grey long gown, no hat, speaking
Shanghai dialect,
came to my office and stated that his friend was suffering
from bubo, and requested my attendance.

Bringing with me a surgical instrument case I accom-
panied the above described person and proceeded to the China
Hotel in two public rickshas. On arrival the person paid
the ricksha fares, and we entered the hotel. Ascending to
the 4th Floor in the lift I followed this man and entered

第2页。

直到“八一三”敌对行动爆发前，我的妻子刘陈氏曾是通山路东华里2号华年眼科医院的业主，为期两年。本月（十月）初，我的妻子获得一张“通行证”后，回到上述医院继续执业。

上述医院由我的妻子刘陈氏创办，她是1935年毕业于虹口路中国医学院眼科班的毕业生。

今天下午（1938年10月17日）约4点，我接到一个电话，来电者称需要我去中国饭店诊治一名病人，并补充说稍后会派人来接我。我去饭店出诊是很平常的事，所以我并未在意电话中的安排。

约半小时后，一名中国男子来到我的诊所，其体貌特征如下：
年龄约22或23岁，面色苍白的长脸，长发中分，身穿深灰色长衫，未戴帽子，讲上海话，
他来称他的朋友患有腹股沟淋巴结炎（bubo），请求我出诊。

我带上一个外科器械箱，陪同上述描述的人，乘坐两辆公共人力车前往中国饭店。到达后，那人支付了车费，我们进入饭店。乘电梯上到四楼，我跟着这个人进入了

Age about 40, hair cut short, wearing a coffee

coloured long gown, height - shorter than me. /

Age about 40, medium build, wearing white short jacket,

As it was dark in the room I asked the occupants

410房间，我发现一名男子正坐在桌旁使用电话簿，其体貌特征如下：
年龄约40岁，短发，身穿咖啡色长衫，身高比我矮。/ 讲上海话。
上述第二名男子告诉我，他无法从电话簿中查到我的号码。我回答说，以前我用的是邻居上海衡器厂的电话——电话号码42778，但最近我在住所安装了电话号码44116，该号码将在新版电话簿发行前列入。
接着他问我是否认识哈同花园的一位姓龚（Chung）的人，是此人把我介绍给他的。我记得有一位叫龚炳生（Chung Ping Sung）的人，他有三个兄弟，即 (2) 龚国良（Chung Kuo Liang）和 (3) 龚国（Chung Kuo Tsung），但我记不起老大的名字。他们四人以前住在哈同花园，但现在已搬至金家巷（Kyung Ka Hong）26号，均为哈同先生的雇员。
这时，所谓的病人站了起来，其体貌特征如下：
年龄约40岁，中等身材，身穿白色短夹克、灰色裤子和灰色背心，身高与我相仿，
他从房间的床上起来，走到我面前，用宁波话招呼我陪他去浴室检查他的腹股沟淋巴结炎。
由于房间里很暗，我问在场的人

pages.en:
Sheet No.4.

to put on the light, but received an answer from the 2nd
described person who was seated in the room, that the same
was out of order.
Accompanied by the alleged sick man I went into
the bath-room immediately followed by the 1st described
person (the man who had been sent for me at my office in
the afternoon), who produced a pistol at my chest, asking
me not to move. In the meantime, the "sick man" handcuff-
ing my two hands gagged my mouth with a xxx piece of news-
paper. This man also tied my feet by means of a length of
cloth. I sat on the edge of a bath-basin in the room, not
being able to move or resist. Then the young man (the 1st
described person) wrote something on my forehead with a
Chinese pen, but I did not know what he had written thereon.
Following this the "sick man" asked me to lay down in the
bath-basin. I stood up and using my power got off my right
hand from the handcuffs, but was then pushed down to the
floor by the "sick man" who pressed himself on my back (I
was facing the floor). Then I was struck on my head with
a pistol butt and, at the same time, I heard the "sick man"
shouting: "K! K! K!" (meaning fire shots). One or two shots
were fired, and I felt bleeding on my head. I kept still
on the floor, but later I found that I was covered with a
bed quilt, and the occupants of the room departed. Then I
untied my feet, coming out of the room was met by a white
uniformed teaboy in the corridor who brought me to the
accountant's office, and the Police Station was informed
pages.zh:
第4页。

把灯打开，但坐在房间里的上述第二名男子回答说灯坏了。
在那名所谓病人的陪同下，我走进浴室，紧随其后的是上述第一名男子（下午派到我诊所接我的人），他掏出手枪指着我的胸口，叫我不要动。与此同时，“病人”给我的双手戴上手铐，并用一块xxx报纸塞住我的嘴。这人还用一条布带绑住了我的双脚。我坐在房间里的浴盆边缘，无法移动或反抗。然后，那个年轻人（上述第一名男子）用毛笔在我的额头上写了些什么，但我不知道他写的是什么。
随后，“病人”让我躺在浴盆里。我站起来，用力挣脱了右手的 handcuffs（手铐），但随即被“病人”推倒在地，他压在我的背上（我面朝地板）。接着，我的头部被枪托击中，同时我听到“病人”喊道：“K! K! K!”（意为开枪）。开了一两枪，我感到头部流血。我静静地躺在地板上，但后来我发现身上盖着一条床被，房间里的人离开了。然后我解开脚上的束缚，走出房间，在走廊里遇到一名穿白色制服的茶房，他把我带到会计室，并通过电话通知了警署

pages.en:
Sheet No.5.

of the occurrence through telephone.
        I have never been concerned in Political activities,
nor have I entered any parties. I have no enemies; no neglig-
ence occurred during my practice. I have no paramours and
I never attend ballrooms, sing song houses and brothels.
        However, I wish to state that at the time I attended
the room, the young man (1st described) pointing his pistol
at my chest told me that I was a Chinese traitor. After
having handcuffed my two hands, they stated they would either
kill me or release me pending their investigations. They had
searched my person.
        I do not know the reason why as to my being victimized.

                Signed and cross-marked:
                        Liu.
pages.zh:
第5页。

发生了此事。
        我从未参与政治活动，也未加入任何党派。我没有仇敌；在执业过程中没有发生过疏忽。我没有情妇，也从不光顾舞厅、歌女场所和妓院。
        然而，我要声明，当我进入房间时，那个年轻人（上述第一名描述者）用手枪指着我的胸口，告诉我我是汉奸。给我的双手戴上手铐后，他们声称要么杀了我，要么在调查后释放我。他们搜了我的身。
        我不知道我成为受害者的原因。

                签名并画押：
                        刘。

CHINA PRESS.

NOV 6 1938

Local Doctor
Lives Despite
2 Head Wounds

Revenge Is Believed
Motive For Friday
Night Shooting

Dr. Lieu Poo-kung, 33, Chinese
physician who was seriously wound-
ed Friday evening when a lone
gunman opened fire upon him, was
still alive last night. It is now
believed that he may live.

The doctor was struck by two
bullets. One entered the throat but
missed the jugular vein. The other
penetrated the ear but apparently
did not strike the brain.

Dr. Lieu only recently recovered
from injuries sustained October 17
when he was lured into a room in
the China Hotel, Kweichow Road.
According to the doctor, he was
attacked by two men.

Handcuffed And Stabbed

They placed handcuffs on him
and then stabbed him with a pen-
knife, he said. He also told the
police that the men responsible for
attacking him were armed robbers
recently released from prison where
they had served a term for looting
his home.

Friday evening, about 6.30 o'clock,
Dr. Lieu was on his way to his
home at House 10, Lane 108 Con-
naught Road. Just as he entered
the lane from the street, a lone
gunman, said to have been dressed
in a "Sun Yat-sen" uniform, step-
ped into the picture and opened fire
at the doctor.

Doctor Hit Twice

Two bullets struck the doctor
while a third bullet wounded a
bystander. The latter is a student
named Lu Zoong-sz. His condition
is not serious.

Detectives of the Gordon Road
Station are continuing their inves-
tigation of the case. They are still
inclined to believe the theory that
the shooting was staged for reasons
of revenge.

刘步公（Lieu Poo-kung）医生，33 岁，中国医师，周五傍晚遭一名单独行动的枪手开枪射击，身受重伤，昨晚仍存活。目前认为他有望生还。

该医生身中两弹。一颗射入喉咙，但未伤及颈静脉。另一颗穿透耳朵，但显然未击中大脑。

刘医生最近才从 10 月 17 日遭受的伤害中恢复过来，当时他被诱骗至贵州路的中国饭店（China Hotel）的一个房间。据刘医生称，他遭到两名男子的袭击。

被戴上手铐并遭刺伤

他说，他们给他戴上手铐，然后用小刀刺他。他还告诉警方，袭击他的人是有武装抢劫前科的罪犯，近期刚从监狱释放，此前因洗劫他的家而服刑。

周五傍晚约 6 点 30 分，刘医生正前往位于康纳特路（Connaught Road）108 弄 10 号的家中。就在他从街道进入弄堂时，一名据称身穿“中山装”的单独行动的枪手突然出现，向医生开火。

医生两度中弹

两颗子弹击中医生，第三颗子弹击伤了一名旁观者。后者是一名名叫陆宗思（Lu Zoong-sz，音译）的学生。其伤势不重。

戈登路捕房的侦探正在继续调查此案。他们仍倾向于认为，此次枪击是出于报复原因而策划的。
